teacher_info.teaching_style:
I expect to have simple and relaxed conversation about topics chosen by the student or a topic that might arise from the conversation. If nothing arise I' m happy to start a conversation asking a question and giving time to the student to answer at his own pace. I will ask if he/she will be ok to be corrected during the conversation. I will take notes that I will be using at the end of the lesson.
Each session will have an "introduction": about us, our week, our day. A "middle": where we get the most learning and an "end": with a feedback to each others on how we can improve to make this more efficient.
After each session I will give a little homework assignment based on my intuition.
